comments.requestedBody: PF-OPUX-v1 Wave 1 (2026-09-22): implemented the current-status/next-step panel over existing session, step, runtime and command data. Handed-off/terminal states take precedence; Completed never implies Saved. Existing visible/enabled commands remain authoritative. Recommended actions are visually emphasized; new exact review targets receive non-activating focus. Routed WPF input tests cover repeated Enter/Space, stale releases, target/job changes, double-click suppression and fresh keyboard activation. Interactive hosted keyboard focus/navigation and fresh physical mouse activation remain unverified: one hidden-host capability probe failed to establish real device state. This is an evidence gap, not a demonstrated product failure. The combined targeted run currently passes 228/228. An observed manual-crop layout regression was fixed and its original smoke assertion remains unchanged. Isolated synthetic WPF captures were inspected in en and zh-CN; human workstation/novice checks remain NOT RUN. The authorized scope/AC8 focus clarification was saved and read back. Fresh independent review found one glossary re-entry wording defect; it was corrected and re-reviewed, with no remaining actionable product defect found. Exact commands, evidence and review limits are recorded separately in docs/codex/printflow-operator-ux-backlog/WAVE1_PLAN.md. No workflow-engine, delivery, import-contract or Jira status changes.
